reason: This PR changes core planner predicate-pushdown semantics in `pkg/planner/core`, not just a local helper. Even though the diff is small and scoped to `Projection` over `TableDual`, optimizer rewrite changes in `rule_predicate_push_down.go` can hide wrong-result or expression-evaluation/order regressions, which is exactly the kind of planner-semantic risk worth a focused deep review.
